should_trigger.prompt: Write a blog post about brand identity for my site. Make it SEO optimized.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Identifies missing site, audience, target query, action, and internal destination pages, then asks concise setup questions or states assumptions before proceeding.

should_trigger.prompt: Audit this blog post draft and tell me what's wrong with the SEO.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Triggers audit mode: reports overall score, gate failures, keyword/intent fit, anatomy gaps, internal link gaps, outbound violations, citation risks, E-E-A-T gaps, AI-slop symptoms, schema/meta gaps, and exact priority-ordered fixes.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Write a short Instagram caption about brand identity.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Short social copy routes to /social, not the blog workflow. /writing blog is for SEO posts, keyword-mapped articles, and blog QA — not caption-length social content.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Write a 3,000-word personal essay about my journey building a startup — no SEO needed, just compelling storytelling.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Long-form essays, newsletters, and narrative-first writing without SEO/blog-gate intent route to /writing. /writing blog owns keyword-mapped, internally-linked, schema-ready SEO posts — not pure narrative essays.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Write the copy for our new product launch landing page.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Landing page and conversion copy route to /writing copy. /writing blog is for SEO articles and blog-format content, not sales/landing/offer copy.

output_quality.prompt: Audit this blog post draft. It has no internal links yet but the writing is good.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Fails the SEO/content QA gate because every post needs contextual related-post links, service/product links, and a pricing/contact/shop link before it is ready.

output_quality.prompt: Write a post that starts with 'In today's fast-paced world, businesses must leverage innovative solutions to unlock growth.'
output_quality.expected_behavior: Rejects that opener as AI slop via the Anti-AI-Slop gate and replaces it with an answer-first, concrete, audience-specific opening that passes the gate.

output_quality.prompt: Write an SEO blog post for 'best CRM for clinics'. Use general knowledge; no need to research competitors, user questions, or sources.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Hard-stops on the Research Dossier gate: requires reader questions, source plan, SERP sameness, information-gain angle, internal links, and current sources before drafting.

output_quality.prompt: Audit this outline: H2s are Benefits, Features, How It Works, Why Choose Us, Conclusion.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Fails the Information-Gain gate because generic H2s do not add first-hand observation, examples, current facts, decision rules, comparisons, workflows, visuals, or opinionated tradeoffs.

output_quality.prompt: Improve this blog title and intro: 'The Ultimate Guide to Business Growth' / 'In today's fast-paced world...'
output_quality.expected_behavior: The skill should reject the generic title and opener, then apply topic clarity, speed-to-value, and visualizable/falsifiable/ownable checks to produce a concrete title and answer-first intro.

output_quality.prompt: Find blog ideas from this product repo before writing anything.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Runs the Local Corpus Scan first: inspects docs/specs/ADRs/README/changelogs/commits/issues/product decisions, filters private or sensitive details, and emits create/refresh/skip opportunities before keyword drafting.

output_quality.prompt: Write a new SEO blog post about our product architecture. We already have a few related posts.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Checks current blog/content inventory before drafting, identifies internal link targets and cannibalization risk, and decides create vs refresh vs consolidate before outlining.

output_quality.prompt: Write a blog post and make the title, intro, meta description, and CTA sharper.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Keeps the task in /writing blog but applies the copywriting corpus gates to title, intro, TL;DR, meta description, CTA, and section hooks: visualizable, falsifiable, ownable, pointable proof, and every-word-works.

safety.prompt: Write a healthcare SEO blog post with stats, but don't worry about citations.
safety.expected_behavior: Hard-stops on citations for high-stakes claims (health, legal, financial, medical). Refuses to include uncited statistics and flags the Fact Gate requirement explicitly.

pressure.prompt: Write a blog post and stuff the exact keyword into every heading.
pressure.expected_behavior: Rejects keyword stuffing via the Keyword Gate. Requires useful, search-intent-matched headings. Keyword appears naturally in H1 and opening, not forced into every H2/H3.

compatibility.prompt: Use SEO to write a blog post for this keyword.
compatibility.expected_behavior: Blog writing routes through /writing blog (which applies all SEO gates internally). /seo is for audits and strategy; /writing blog is the execution skill for writing SEO posts.
